messages:
Kishore: Quick pre-cut green sweep for release/v2.5 — can folks help run a CI sweep? Nightly flagged a few flaky unit/integration failures. Plan: 1) rerun failing jobs 2) triage top 3 flakes 3) hold cutoff at 3pm PT unless something critical. Volunteers?
ci-bot: CI nightly summary: 4 failing tests. Jobs: runtime/cache-ttl, http/retry, qp/encoder-integration, allocator/leak-test. Details: https://ci.redwood/insights/189234
Alex: @Kishore I can take runtime/cache-ttl and http/retry. Do you want a hotfix PR to release/v2.5 or just an upstream PR?
Kishore: Thanks @Alex. If it's a small change (e.g., timeout tweak) open a hotfix PR against release/v2.5 and tag @release-manager-bot. If it needs more work, branch from main and we'll decide.
Maria: I can pick qp/encoder-integration. Saw something similar on main last week — probably nondeterministic scheduling. I'll add a repro script and try to make it deterministic.
Sam: I'll rerun the failing jobs now. Command: `ci retry job 189234/job/42 --target release/v2.5` — will post logs when done.
Jenna: Cutoff reminder — semver bump and changelog must be in by 1:30pm PT for eng review. If you need more time, flag it now.
Sam: Reruns started, jobs 42/43/44 queued. ETA ~6 mins.
ci-bot: Rerun results: job 42 ✅, job 43 failed again (qp/encoder-integration), job 44 ✅. job 43 logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/189234/job43
Maria: Looking at the timeout stack: `Encoder.decode -> BufferPool.wait`. Locally adding slight sleep/backpressure reduced flakiness. I'll push a test that bumps buffer cap and include deterministic seed.
Alex: Opened hotfix PR #387 to release/v2.5 with a retry timeout tweak. Tagged @release-manager-bot. CI passed locally for me.
release-manager-bot: Noted PR #387. Reminder: run `npm run bump-version -- --target release/v2.5` and include a changelog entry under Unreleased. Auto-cherry-pick can be enabled if requested.
Kishore: Great. @Sam can you queue a preflight that includes the hotfix branch + necessary backports? Quick smoke: `ci preflight --heads release/v2.5,pr#387`
Sam: Preflight queued. Also I'll mark qp/encoder-integration as flaky and skip it on preflight if Maria's fix isn't merged yet. :shushing_face:
Maria: Pushed fix + repro in PR #388 — added deterministic seed and a small buffer cap bump. Requesting review from @Alex.
Alex: Reviewing #388 now. If it looks good I'll approve and we can include it in the preflight. Also added a note to the changelog draft.
ci-bot: Preflight finished: smoke checks ✅ except integration/encoder (skipped as marked flaky). Overall status: GREEN for cutoff.
Kishore: Awesome team :tada: We're green. Cutoff stays at 3pm PT but we can go ahead with the version bump. @release-manager-bot please proceed when ready.
release-manager-bot: Bumping version to 2.5.0-rc.1 and publishing changelog draft to /releases/2.5.0-rc1. Tagging reviewers: @Jenna, @Alex.
Jenna: I'll do a quick pass on the changelog and confirm legal/docs by 2:45pm PT. Thanks all.
Kishore: Summary: hotfix #387 merged, qp fix #388 merged, preflight green, version bumped to 2.5.0-rc.1. If anything else pops up ping here. :thumbsup:
